headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Hi-oT (Hyundai Autoever) KOCOM wallpad-based Korean apartments.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Displayed in Homebridge logs and the bridge name.

userid.title: Hi-oT User ID
userid.description: The same ID you log into the Hi-oT mobile app with.

password.title: Hi-oT Password
password.description: Stored only in Homebridge config. The plugin caches a server-issued token on first login and skips the plaintext path afterward.

pollingIntervalMs.title: Polling Interval (milliseconds)
pollingIntervalMs.description: How often the background poller refreshes device state from the Hi-oT cloud and pushes values into the HomeKit cache.

debugLogging.title: Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Emit verbose logs (device list, HTTP details). Tokens and passwords are still suppressed.

baseUrl.title: Hi-oT Base URL (advanced)
baseUrl.description: Override only if Hi-oT moves its endpoint. Leave default for standard deployments.

pushRegistrationToken.title: Push Registration Token (advanced)
pushRegistrationToken.description: Optional. APNs/FCM token sent during login. Only needed to match production app fingerprinting; leave blank for normal use.
